answer: Auditors compare payout claims to signed receipts for umber deliveries at a harbor. Each seller reserves bond H and may withdraw at most G only after an audit-and-appeal window. With unpredictable fraud detection probability p, setting pH > G makes fabrication unprofitable. A hollow shell cannot cash out and vanish before inspection; n parallel sellers require nH locked capital. Only proven fabricated claims forfeit bonds. This prices throwaway identities, but depends on honest receipt issuers and independent audits.
